s1.text:
The corridor hums with electricity. Blue light pulses through cables that line the walls like veins. This is the Cipher's domain — a place where information flows faster than blood.

A terminal flickers to life as you pass. Text scrolls across the screen:

> CHALLENGER DETECTED. SCANNING...
> WEAKNESSES CATALOGUED.
> PROCEED. OR DON'T.

Three passages branch ahead. One marked DATA, one marked POWER, one marked OVERRIDE.
s1.ascensionText: You've been here before. The terminal flickers the same greeting, but a new line appears: > RETURNING CHALLENGER. UPDATED PROFILE LOADED. The Cipher has been studying you between visits.
s1.imagePrompt: A cyberpunk server room corridor with blue pulsing cables on walls, a flickering terminal with green text, three passages marked with neon signs, dark tech atmosphere

choices.text: DATA — learn what the Cipher knows about you
OVERRIDE — try to hack the Cipher's home turf

s2a.text:
The data streams reveal the Cipher's pattern: steal charges first, overwhelm second. It's a predator that feeds on your abilities.

But the data also shows a flaw. When it steals a charge, there's a 0.3-second window where its guard drops. Brute force in that window.
s2a.imagePrompt: Holographic data streams showing combat patterns, a glowing diagram of a humanoid figure with highlighted weak points, cyberpunk tech analysis, dark fantasy

choices.text: Rewrite the Cipher's combat algorithms — turn its own code against it

s2b.text:
The system fights back. Screens flash red. A surge of static runs through the floor, and your hands tingle.

The Cipher's voice echoes through speakers: "Every system has a flaw. Yours is overconfidence."

But the surge also overloaded a junction box. Sparks fly from a panel, revealing raw wiring underneath.
s2b.imagePrompt: A server room with red flashing screens, electrical sparks flying from an overloaded junction box, exposed wiring, tension and danger, cyberpunk dark fantasy

choices.text: Rip out the wires — disrupt the Cipher's systems
Retreat and find another way around
You recognize the circuit architecture — reroute the surge into the Cipher's defenses

s2c.text:
You slam your fist into the power conduit. It cracks. Sparks rain down, and the hallway goes dark for two heartbeats before backup power kicks in.

In those two heartbeats of darkness, you hear the Cipher's voice glitch: "Err—every syst—has a fl—"

You rattled it. Good.
s2c.imagePrompt: A shattered power conduit with sparks raining down in a dark corridor, backup lights flickering on with blue emergency glow, raw destruction, cyberpunk dark fantasy

choices.text: Keep breaking things — chaos is your advantage
Use the disruption to sneak deeper

s3.text:
The Cipher's chamber is a sphere of floating screens. Data cascades like waterfalls. At the center, a figure made of light and code shifts between forms.

It turns to face you. Its eyes are search queries.
s3.imagePrompt: A spherical chamber of floating holographic screens with cascading data, a humanoid figure made of light and code at the center, cyberpunk boss arena, dark fantasy

choices.text: Rush in — don't give it time to analyze you
Outthink it — you've seen its patterns
Trust your gut — sometimes luck beats logic

s4_final.text:
The Cipher speaks, its voice a chorus of stolen frequencies:

"Every system has a flaw. Let me show you yours."
s4_final.ascensionText: The Cipher's form stabilizes faster this time. "I've modeled you," it says, screens flickering with replays of your last fight. "Every pattern. Every tell. You won't surprise me twice."
s4_final.imagePrompt: A figure made of pure code and light raising its hands, screens shattering around it, data becoming weapons, cyberpunk boss encounter, dark fantasy
